bullets.title: Project Nim
bullets.note: From the official description: “From the Oscar-winning team behind [Man on Wire](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh39ore/opfkhq/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9kcC9CMDAxTkVJOTZP) comes the story of Nim, the chimpanzee who became the focus of a landmark 1970s experiment to show that an ape could learn to communicate with language if raised and nurtured like a human child. But as Nim's natural instincts take over and the humans trusted with his well-being fail to protect him, Project Nim uncovers the unflinching and extraordinary journey of one animal thrust into human society.”

bullets.title: The STEAGLE webcam cover
bullets.note: , found via [Kevin Rose](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh39ore/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9rZXZpbnJvc2U=) and [Richard Reis](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh39ore/xksph6/aHR0cHM6Ly9tZWRpdW0uZnJlZWNvZGVjYW1wLm9yZy9ob3ctdG8tdGhpbmstbGlrZS1hLXByb2dyYW1tZXItbGVzc29ucy1pbi1wcm9ibGVtLXNvbHZpbmctZDFkOGJmMWRlN2Qy). Long ago, my friend and expert hacker [Samy Kamkar](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/92unw45ooanh39ore/60aeh8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vdXNlci9zNG15aw==) explained how easy it was for him to hijack and “own” a laptop camera for remote recording. I immediately started using Sticky notes, tape, and other makeshift means for covering my camera when not in use. This STEAGLE cover offers a much sturdier and more elegant solution. If you do anything in front of your laptop that you might not want recorded (likely), I suggest practicing safe Internet and wrapping it up. This is one option.

bullets.title: Outside magazine nominated
bullets.note: Bozeman as one of the best towns for skiing, and I couldn’t resist plucking this part from their description of the city: “Cradled by 10,000-foot peaks, hyaline streams, and ragged wilderness, the fastest-growing town in the state has a bustling college campus and brains to match: Residents may wear cowboy hats, but the Ph.D. rate is twice the national average. Free live music in city parks during summer and community sporting events like the spectacular 20-mile Bridger Ridge Run keep the blood flowing.” I’m considering doing a live podcast there just as an excuse to explore.
